metadata.credit: Port data: ShipPortX (Africa), NGA World Port Index (worldwide)
notes: ShipPortX records win for Africa; WPI values never overwrite them.
ocean_going is a heuristic: known depth or draft >= 7.0 m, otherwise port type (ShipPortX) or harbor size medium/large (WPI); null when unknown.
WPI cargo flags are mostly unknown ('U'), so the cargo filter under-reports WPI ports.
